import os, sys, copy, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
import torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-kuxslufk/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_csp_weui")
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(29500+ws)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128, hidden_size=64, intermediate_size=128, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = copy.deepcopy(model)
    inputs=[torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(3)]; targets=[torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    for x,y in zip(inputs,targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1,128), y.reshape(-1))/3; l.backward()
    maxd=0; n=0
    for (nm,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n+=1; maxd=max(maxd,(p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(rank, "loss", loss, "params w/ grad", n, "max grad diff", maxd)
    dist.destroy_process_group()

for ws in (1,2): mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
